name: Voxel Hashing with Mean Aggregation
definition: A GPU-accelerated voxelization pipeline for LiDAR point clouds that converts 3D points into voxel features using a hash table for coordinate mapping, scatter operations for feature accumulation, and a reduce_mean kernel for feature aggregation.
summary: Voxel Hashing with Mean Aggregation is a GPU-accelerated LiDAR voxelization method that uses open-addressing hash tables for deduplication and scatter-mean reduction for feature aggregation.
